    n = instance["n"]
    if n <= 2:

    rest = list(range(1, n))
    for perm in itertools.permutations(rest):
        order = (0,) + perm
        ok = True

            a = order[i]
            b = order[(i + 1) % n]
            if (min(a, b), max(a, b)) not in edge_set:

    return False

    m = instance["num_vars"]
    clauses = instance["clauses"]
    for bits in itertools.product([False, True], repeat=m):
